heroHeadline: Huawei Ascend 910C Completes Full-Parameter Post-Training of DeepSeek V4-Pro — China's Domestic AI Stack Validated at Frontier Scale; DeepSeek Finalizes $7.4B Round at $59B Valuation
heroSubtitle: June 5, 2026 — In the most technically significant milestone for China's AI self-reliance since the Tau Scaling Law announcement (May 25), a research consortium led by Huawei, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, Harbin Institute of Technology Shenzhen, and Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data completed full-parameter post-training of DeepSeek's V4-Pro model — its largest at 1.6 trillion parameters — entirely on Huawei Ascend 910C chips (South China Morning Post, June 5). Full-parameter post-training is the most computationally demanding phase of the AI development lifecycle; until this milestone, Ascend had been validated primarily for inference. China now possesses the complete AI development pipeline — data curation, pre-training, fine-tuning, post-training, and inference — executable on domestic hardware without a single Nvidia GPU. The US export control strategy's primary lever (GPU access for frontier model training) has demonstrably lost effectiveness at the level that matters most. Contemporaneously: DeepSeek is finalizing its first external funding round at $7.4 billion (50B yuan), with a $52–59 billion post-investment valuation (Bloomberg, June 3). Investors include founder Liang Wenfeng (~$2.8B personal commitment), Tencent (~$1.4B), CATL (~$700M), and the National AI Industry Investment Fund — fewer than 10 investors, structured entirely without US capital access. The June 3–5 window also produced: Tencent's WeChat AI agent regulatory filing (June 3) and a historic +10.46% share surge adding $53 billion in market cap (Caixin Global, June 4) — WeChat's 1.3 billion users are entering the AI agent era in the world's most integrated super-app; Senator Elizabeth Warren invited Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on June 11 on China AI chip sales and export control compliance (CNBC, June 4); and Zhongji Innolight Co. overtook CATL as China's largest CSI 300 constituent at 5.3% weighting (SCMP, June 5), signaling China's benchmark equity index has repriced from the EV transition cycle to the AI infrastructure cycle. China's AI self-reliance stack as of June 5, 2026: Training — validated on Huawei Ascend 910C at 1.6T parameter frontier scale; Inference — DeepSeek V4-Pro at $0.003625/M input tokens; Capital — $52–59B DeepSeek valuation, $138B+ AI unicorn wave, all domestic funding; Trade secret protection — AI algorithms and training data legally protected (effective June 2); Outbound investment controls — all tech/data/personnel transfers require approval (effective July 1); Counter-sanctions capability — 63-sector framework published.
